answer: Let every identity climb a terrace of capped earnings: a newcomer starts on the lowest terrace, where payouts are tiny and every job is checked by two unrelated reviewers. Only after a long run of verified work — each success a pearl added to its record — does the agent rise to a higher terrace with larger jobs. A reef of counterparties anchors that record, so a fake identity cannot buy its way up: it must pay the time cost of honest work at each level, and spawning a thousand copies multiplies that cost a thousandfold while the caps keep fraud worthless.
